questions.question: An input drift alert fired before new labels arrived. What follows?
options: Retrain and automatically replace the active model.
Investigate the change and gather quality evidence before choosing a response.
Declare accuracy has decreased by the drift score.
questions.explanation: An unlabeled drift alert is evidence of a distribution change under the detector, not direct evidence of accuracy loss. Investigate data integrity, affected slices, service health and delayed outcomes. Retraining and promotion require their own declared quality gates.
optionFeedback: Drift can reflect harmless distribution changes or instrumentation faults. Investigate data and labeled quality before promotion.

An unlabeled drift alert is evidence of a distribution change under the detector, not direct evidence of accuracy loss. Investigate data integrity, affected slices, service health and delayed outcomes. Retraining and promotion require their own declared quality gates.
Input drift and accuracy loss are different observations. Without labels, the detector cannot directly measure accuracy.
